AssetInfo

Type: object

Set of attributes of an asset, representing typical datasheet information of a physical device that can be instantiated and shared in different data exchange contexts:
- as attributes of an asset instance (installed or in stock)
- as attributes of an asset model (product by a manufacturer)
- as attributes of a type asset (generic type of an asset as used in designs/extension planning).

No Additional Properties

SwitchInfo

root SwitchInfo
Type: object

Hash table of SwitchInfo objects

No Additional Properties

SwitchInfo Pattern Property

All properties whose name matches the following regular expression must respect the following conditions

Property name regular expression: ^.+$
root SwitchInfo SwitchInfo
Type: object

<was Switch data.>
Switch datasheet information.

No Additional Properties

SwitchInfo.isUnganged

root SwitchInfo SwitchInfo SwitchInfo.isUnganged
Type: boolean

If true, the switch is not ganged (i.e., a switch phase may be operated separately from other phases).

RecloserInfo.groundTripCapable

root SwitchInfo SwitchInfo RecloserInfo.groundTripCapable
Type: boolean

True if device has ground trip capability.

OldSwitchInfo.loadBreak

True if switch has load breaking capabiity. Unless specified false, this is always assumed to be true for breakers and reclosers.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root SwitchInfo SwitchInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root SwitchInfo SwitchInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root SwitchInfo SwitchInfo IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root TapChangerInfo TapChangerInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root TapChangerInfo TapChangerInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root TapChangerInfo TapChangerInfo IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

WireSpacingInfo

root WireSpacingInfo
Type: object

Hash table of WireSpacingInfo objects

No Additional Properties

WireSpacingInfo Pattern Property

All properties whose name matches the following regular expression must respect the following conditions

Property name regular expression: ^.+$
root WireSpacingInfo WireSpacingInfo
Type: object

Wire spacing data that associates multiple wire positions with the line segment, and allows to calculate line segment impedances. Number of phases can be derived from the number of associated wire positions whose phase is not neutral.

No Additional Properties

WireSpacingInfo.WirePositions

root WireSpacingInfo WireSpacingInfo WireSpacingInfo.WirePositions
Type: array

Array of WirePosition objects

No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root WireSpacingInfo WireSpacingInfo WireSpacingInfo.WirePositions WirePosition
Type: object

Identification, spacing and configuration of the wires of a conductor with respect to a structure.

No Additional Properties

WirePosition.sequenceNumber

root WireSpacingInfo WireSpacingInfo WireSpacingInfo.WirePositions WirePosition WirePosition.sequenceNumber
Type: integer

Numbering for wires on a WireSpacingInfo. Neutrals should be numbered last.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root WireInfo WireInfo anyOf WireInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root WireInfo WireInfo anyOf WireInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root WireInfo WireInfo anyOf OverheadWireInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root WireInfo WireInfo anyOf OverheadWireInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root WireInfo WireInfo anyOf CableInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root WireInfo WireInfo anyOf CableInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root WireInfo WireInfo anyOf CableInfo IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root WireInfo WireInfo anyOf TapeShieldCableInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root WireInfo WireInfo anyOf TapeShieldCableInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root WireInfo WireInfo anyOf ConcentricNeutralCableInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root WireInfo WireInfo anyOf ConcentricNeutralCableInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root WireInfo WireInfo anyOf ConcentricNeutralCableInfo WireInfo.insulated

True if conductor is insulated.

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndNoLoadTests NoLoadTest IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndNoLoadTests NoLoadTest IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest
Type: object

Short-circuit test results determine mesh impedance parameters. They include load losses and leakage impedances. For three-phase windings, the excitation can be a positive sequence (the default) or a zero sequence. There shall be at least one grounded winding.

IdentifiedObject.description

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

Ravens.cimObjectType

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance Ravens.cimObjectType
Type: enum (of string)

Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

Must be one of:

  • "TransformerCoreAdmittance"

IdentifiedObject.description

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance
Type: array

Array of TransformerMeshImpedance objects

No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance TransformerMeshImpedance
Type: object

Transformer mesh impedance (Delta-model) between transformer ends.
The typical case is that this class describes the impedance between two transformer ends pair-wise, i.e. the cardinalities at both transformer end associations are 1. However, in cases where two or more transformer ends are modelled the cardinalities are larger than 1.

No Additional Properties

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance TransformerMeshImpedance IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest
Type: array

Array of OpenCircuitTest objects

No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest
Type: object

Open-circuit test results verify winding turn ratios and phase shifts. They include induced voltage and phase shift measurements on open-circuit windings, with voltage applied to the energised end. For three-phase windings, the excitation can be a positive sequence (the default) or a zero sequence.

No Additional Properties

IdentifiedObject.description

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

TransformerEndInfo.phaseAngleClock

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.phaseAngleClock
Type: integer

Winding phase angle where 360 degrees are represented with clock hours, so the valid values are {0, ..., 11}. For example, to express the second winding in code 'Dyn11', set attributes as follows: 'endNumber'=2, 'connectionKind' = Yn and 'phaseAngleClock' = 11.

TransformerEndInfo.endNumber

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.endNumber
Type: integer

Number for this transformer end, corresponding to the end's order in the PowerTransformer.vectorGroup attribute. Highest voltage winding should be 1.

IdentifiedObject.name

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

IdentifiedObject.description

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.description

root ShuntCompensatorInfo ShuntCompensatorInfo IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root ShuntCompensatorInfo ShuntCompensatorInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root ShuntCompensatorInfo ShuntCompensatorInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.
